turns.player_input: I try to climb the townhouse overlooking the square to get a better view.
turns.gm_text: You try to clamber up the side of the townhouse overlooking the busy square, finding some weathered stones and narrow ledges for handholds. The slick rain and soot darkened walls make the ascent precarious, and the townhouses here are old but solidly built. Despite your careful efforts, reaching a vantage point above the square proves beyond easy reach this way—your hands slip, and you steady yourself before deciding the climb is too risky from this side. From this near-climb, you glimpse that the townhouse bears the sigil of House Verevin, a noble family watching the district closely. Above the square, you notice flickers of movement—shadows dart across adjacent rooftops, suggesting watchers or sentries keeping an eye on the gate line and the crowded street below. The obscured view and precarious position leave much uncertain, but this vantage hints at a network of eyes watching the checkpoint. Perhaps another, safer approach could reveal more or a local familiar with the rooftops might guide you.
